scripts.check-outdated: bun outdated && cd client && bun outdated && cd ../server && bun outdated
scripts.deploy:patch: bun version --workspaces patch && git add **/package.json && bun version patch --include-workspace-root --force
scripts.deploy:minor: bun version --workspaces minor && git add **/package.json && bun version minor --include-workspace-root --force
scripts.deploy:major: bun version --workspaces major && git add **/package.json && bun version major --include-workspace-root --force
scripts.predeploy: git switch main && git pull origin main --rebase --tags && git merge origin staging
scripts.postdeploy: git push origin main --tags && git switch staging && git merge origin main && git push
